title: What the Notches Keep

arc.title: The Cold Stone
arc.subtitle: a warm stone, already going cold

epigraph.text: The hand goes to its own count before it goes to a person, and the mouth comes last. What is kept in wood is not entered on a slate; what is kept under wool gathers no figure.
epigraph.attribution: Two sayings of the Clay Yard, told in the second firing of Smoke

pov: Daniel Marchetti (Corin), close third-person past tense inside a body of two hundred and forty-three to two hundred and forty-five days, six months and sixty-three days to six months and sixty-five days, carried everywhere and told by nobody. The surgeon's register colours the noticing --- the file turned out as instruments on a towel and found exact, complete and worth nothing; the order of reaching read as a record-first hand, the ninth in the district's procession, held apart from the eight already filed; a tally of firings kept notched in wood and carried where no slate can take a figure off it; the dressed grain's read figure held apart from the figure paid and from the cost of hands and damp; a cost-question sent to the pot and a number out of a fist arriving nowhere; the wrong wind's sweet edge arriving on the wind that brought it and going out on it, a direction and not a second edge paid; the question opened as a surgeon opens a wound and found to have no witness at the bottom --- without a present-tense Chicago break or a tagged remembered line; the old life stays offstage and there is no departure from his eyes, no Court, collector, Waiting Room or back-room interior, no hearing beyond six, no seventh of the full note, no tenth stopping before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, no fifth telling of the burned slate, no third telling of the counting room shut in the war, no fourth likeness of the pot saying, no fifth asking and no witness to the row question, no eighth green or eighth shape, no third gap, no fourth likeness made a cause, no calling of the loan, no payer named for the carried fire's fifth or for any warmth under this roof, no private record opened, read or copied, no figure given for the dressed grain or for the hand that did not come back, no name spoken over the green or the shape, no sale or betrayal paid, no lesson made of the first opening of Smoke, which is behind the household and not looked at again, and no ending

scenes.title: The Day Not Yet Earned
scenes.synopsis: First of six entries, first dated heading and the chapter's only drop cap: Day 243, Smoke 4, Fourthday, small hours under the Vail kiln-house roof, then before first grey and into the morning at the hearth and the kiln mouth. No recap: the hand came down against the fold on the sixtieth answer and that coordination is set down like a tool, never recalled as a sign, growth, reaching, gift or power; the one opening before the kiln on Smoke 1 lies behind the household and is not looked at again as sign, lesson, mending or payment. Count exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody at 242 going into **243**, six months and sixty-three days, told by nobody (T071/T072); first smell hot clay under tallow and wet wool under that, sour Ash breath of the unswept corner called the thaw; first sound the kiln drawing in fours with a gap, not a bell. Smoke came on without a boundary and goes on without one; neither of the district's two month-names is corrected; no market, no Cross and no bell until Smoke 10 (Day 249), six mornings ahead and unbrought. Three counts in three places --- the carried fire's four low pulls and the silence where the fifth should be under the floor (payer unnamed two hundred and forty-three days, T088), the river's note of water over water through the finger's-width door, the boards' four nails, four and a thumb-width knot --- none rising into another, for agreeing them would want a payer and none stands to any (T061/T082). Body inventory: one stiff leathery brown-edged barley crust two inches from the ear, empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold stopped at cheek, temple and the bare wrist-joint where the wool rides back; the afterdrop waiting past a warming nobody in this house will perform. Sella goes to the fire before the basket, tells it the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it*, counts under her breath toward no opening, pushes coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist so the grey streak shows pale; the widow's mark hangs untouched at a shelf, a well, a rack and a basket, because the hand goes to the mark before the kiln and at no other hour (T058/T079). The dressed grain is turned under its wool for damp, spread thin, gathered back by the handful and the fold set flat; it changes state and gains no figure, counted in glances, handfuls and by the carrying arm's weight that knows weight and not cost, entered on no slate and laid across none of the absences (T077). Garl kept in objects, his name unspoken two hundred and forty-three days, no collector up or down the clay road (T009/T013/T092). The first hand question: the hand outside the wool goes up an inch toward the low note through the finger's-width door and comes down at once on the river's note --- answer **sixty-one** filed on the sixth place with no payer named, not a longer reach, miss entered as a finding, hearing, seventh, tenth stopping, payment, held change, key, power or rule (T061/T082).

scenes.title: Four Nails and a Knot
scenes.synopsis: Second entry of Day 243, no new dated heading: afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the salt coat and hollow seat, the kindling, the flagstones, the Vail wheel-shed edge, the back room (rendered only as a direction and a sound), the clay road at the going of the light and the bed. Afternoon thins without ending; heat into the fold; crust, empty place, frozen thread, cold at cheek--temple--wrist, afterdrop waiting (T061/T082). Garl in objects and not in a story: salt-stiff coat with the left-shoulder crease, hollow wheel-seat with its twenty-year lean, clean dark line and finer grey called the thaw unswept, proverb gone years ago to a pot with no crack, tile debt circling without a name, his name unspoken two hundred and forty-three days; no collector came up or went down the clay road (T009/T013/T092). Sella stands at the loaf shelf with her back to the basket, lips along the two-gapped row with no figure, glances once at the clay jar cold under its glaze and shuts her hand half over nothing, keeps her finger on top of the front edge so the charcoal stays unread, sets the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T100). At the kindling Tarn takes the broom only after it has been instructed, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, sets the small knife at the very edge of its sill with six in the worn thumb-mark where the house can check and the seventh at the lip where it cannot, Garl's unforged collector sentence beside it; the ear-sentence comes to his teeth and goes all the way to the word that would call the loan and stops there with no figure and no name --- a remembered stopping, not a new one --- nine stoppings stand with no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the Seed 16 breath is drawn at the top of the reach and not spent, the loan is uncalled, no collector came on Smoke 4, chest tight since the dark, Ash worked into the knuckle creases in the colour of the clean dark line, pale clip-ring at the left wrist, warm stone cold and unreconciled in its unmarked loft pot (T036/T076, T006). His stroke goes over the shallow bright patch without the half-check and over the road a house sends a man down when it wants a collector, without once turning along it; the loft settles as a direction and nothing more. At the wheel-shed Jorra comes through with meal-fine grey slate dust past the bent little finger and white in the creases where a fist had opened, not bone-coloured slip, dusty and clean forearms on one tray, asking neither which slate broke nor whether it was a birth-slate; he speaks to the wheel before anyone (*It doesn't care whose hands. It cares if they're steady*), tells a pot *You'll do*, knows the full note it will give three turns ahead with air under it and a want in it and withholds it on the near-full tray beside the hearings and never among them; the burned-slate word stands at four and the two shut-room tellings at two, with no fifth and no third, and no name given to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188 (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095, T064). His bent finger goes into the cold damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence, takes the cold out, holds until the end arrives at the pot, moves a hair's breadth and is left standing --- a remembered repetition paired with no other fraction, one piece of iron with two bites and no Grathic word for both mercies. Men unnamed went low into the back room before first grey; *he's not Vail* stays sealed and the promise of the boy's name to the men who burn slates is neither given nor withdrawn. Second hand question: the hand goes up an inch, held for the small intake only and brought down before the letting-go --- answer **sixty-two**, filed with no payer named and held apart from every other object on the tray (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Notches
scenes.synopsis: Third entry, third dated heading: Day 244, Smoke 5, Fifthday, small hours under the Vail roof, then the ordinary morning at the hearth, the loaf shelf, the drying racks, the Clay Yard and the yard well. New day, new date, no recap: **244** exact, six months and sixty-four days, nobody told (T071/T072); fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and forty-four days (T088); widow's mark touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and at no other hour --- not at a shelf, a well, a rack or a basket on this morning (T058/T079); first smell hot clay under tallow, wet wool under that, sour Ash breath of the thaw; first sound the kiln in fours with its gap, no bell, no market and no Cross, for Smoke 10 (Day 249) stands five mornings ahead. The dressed grain is turned under wool for damp, spread thin, gathered back by the handful, the fold set flat; it changes state and gains no figure, entered on no slate and laid across none of the absences (T077). A neighbour at the threshold with a pot asks what the storing will take now the grain is under wool and Sella sends the question to the pot and the weather; a man come down the clay road brings a number up out of a fist toward the yard well, looks at it and puts it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrives nowhere and is not a missing figure; the figure read over the covered grain on Grain 30 is still not the figure paid and the true subtraction stays locked in Berr's box answering nothing for the man carried out on Day 188 (T015/T041/T047 held). Sella lips along the two-gapped row without a figure, glances at the clay jar and shuts her hand half over nothing, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, sets the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T100). **THE CHAPTER'S ONE MEANINGFUL CHANGE, a sighting and an advancement of T080, not a new thread, not paid:** at the yard well a woman of the firing work, new to the district's procession, draws a short strip of birch bark notched along one edge out of her sleeve and passes the nail of a thumb across the notches before her eyes go to the woman who has asked her how many firings the month has taken and before her mouth answers. The hand goes to the record before it goes to the person and before it goes to the pot --- the **ninth** record-first hand-shape in the district, filed on a place of its own beside Berr's twice-wiped thumb, Hessa's inward slate, the soft-cuffed clerk's inward slate at the landing, the charcoal under the Vail shelf, Mira's cords, Orra's knots, Alda's six pages, Dessa's pewter tin, the reed-cutter's cord, the hand that went in on Seed 15 and the hand that carried the glaze-room man out on Day 188, with a finger between every pair and no payer standing under any. What the notches hold is a count of firings, plain as a firing is plain, kept in wood because a slate would want a figure put on it; nothing on the stick waits to be read, no figure comes off it that a clerk could enter, and no joining is made to any other private keeping. She is not Marra, not Hessa, not the soft-cuffed clerk and not an officer; she gives no name for the stick and nobody asks. Third hand question: the hand goes up an inch and is kept to the river's own low interval with no count in the house to hold it against, then comes down on the next note --- answer **sixty-three**, filed with no payer named (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Ninth Hand
scenes.synopsis: Fourth entry of Day 244, no new dated heading: afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the boards fronting the shelf, the hearth, the kindling, the flagstones, the wheel-shed edge, the clay road at the going of the light and the bed. Afternoon thins; heat into the fold; crust, empty place, frozen thread, cold at cheek--temple--wrist, afterdrop waiting. Garl in objects, his name unspoken two hundred and forty-four days, no collector up or down the clay road (T009/T013/T092). Sella gives the fire its instruction, tells it the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it*, counts under her breath toward no opening, leaves the widow's mark as it was. At the kindling Tarn takes the broom only after it is instructed, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, sets the knife where six can be checked and the seventh cannot, brings the ear-sentence all the way to the word that would call the loan and stops there with no figure and no name as a remembered stopping; nine stoppings stand with no tenth, the Seed 16 breath is unspent and the loan uncalled, the collector's road is swept without a turn of the head, Ash in the knuckles, pale clip-ring at the wrist, warm stone cold in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006). At the wheel-shed Jorra parts dust from slip, withholds the note known three turns ahead, keeps the burned slate at four and the shut-room tellings at two, lets his bent finger lead at the damper as a remembered repetition, gives the men in the back room no name and keeps *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise ungiven (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). **T080 advanced, not paid:** the boy turns out the file and places the ninth hand-shape on its own place beside the eighth, a finger between them and fingers between them and the charcoal, the cords, the knots, the pages, the tins, the missing hand and the pale line; nine record-first hands are nine and must not stand up and call themselves a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stands to any. He does not join the notches to the notches of T099, does not read the stick, does not ask the woman, does not let the order of reaching become a cause, a key or a power. The file is checked and unchanged: six hearings beside and never among with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place, three near-full answers advanced and unpaid, three shapings of the pot saying with no fourth likeness made a cause, the fourth burned-slate telling and the two shut-room tellings on their own places, told bell beside heard, told figure beside paid with Grain's third subtraction locked in Berr's box, nine stoppings with no tenth, three held changes plus the loft scrape, the pale line and the held inch on six places, the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth, the dressed grain covered, the returning-line place gone around with a look and no number, the pan's gone ring on its own tray, and the question on its seventh place with four askings and no witness standing (T101 carried, not paid). Fourth hand question: the hand goes up an inch, passes through the small intake, the hold and the letting-go of one of Sella's counted breaths from the room that does not touch his, is kept to the end of the count and comes down where the count ends --- answer **sixty-four**, one rhythm borrowed and one rhythm kept, remembered and not a change made again, filed with no payer named (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Store Under Wool
scenes.synopsis: Fifth entry, fifth dated heading: Day 245, Smoke 6, Sixthday, small hours under the Vail roof, then the ordinary morning at the hearth, the loaf shelf, the drying racks, the Clay Yard, the boards and the terrace. New day, new date, no recap: **245** exact, six months and sixty-five days, nobody told (T071/T072); fire's fifth unpaid two hundred and forty-five days (T088); widow's mark touched once before the kiln on Smoke 1 and at no other hour, not at a shelf, a well, a rack, a road, a basket, an afternoon or a dusk (T058/T079); first smell hot clay under tallow, wet wool under that, sour Ash breath of the thaw; first sound the kiln in fours with its gap, no bell, no market and no Cross; Smoke 10 (Day 249) stands four mornings ahead and is not brought early. The dressed grain is turned under wool for damp, spread thin to finish, gathered back by the handful and the fold set flat; it changes state and gains no figure, counted in glances, handfuls and by the carrying arm's weight that knows weight and not cost, entered on no slate and laid across none of the absences (T077). A neighbour at the threshold asks what the keeping will take now the grain is under wool and is sent to the pot and the weather; a man come down the clay road with the dried pale scurf of mud on his coat skirt brings a number up out of a fist toward the well, looks at it and puts it back into his sleeve, so the figure arrives nowhere. A wrong wind comes up off High Kiln: the sweet edge of lead glaze rides over the boards, touches the fold and goes out on the wind that brought it --- a direction arrived nowhere and not a second edge paid --- and one of the three shapings of the pot saying is let stand again as a saying; three likenesses must not stand up and call themselves a rule, for a rule is an account that has found a payer and none stands to these. No pot is lost, no fourth likeness is made a cause, no name is given to what ailed the man carried out on Day 188 and the sweet edge is not joined to the green at a silent woman's mouth (T064 held). Sella lips along the two-gapped row, glances at the clay jar, shuts her hand half over nothing, keeps her finger on top of the shelf's front edge so the charcoal stays unread, sets the pot handle two inches beyond the reaching hand with a half-beat and no look toward the bed (T100). Garl in objects, his name unspoken two hundred and forty-five days, no collector on the clay road (T009/T013/T092). Fifth hand question: the hand goes up an inch toward the low note through the finger's-width door and is kept through the little silence after Sella's count has ended in the room that does not touch his, then comes down on the river's next low note --- answer **sixty-five**, one rhythm held across the silence and not two rhythms crossed, filed with no payer named (T061/T082).

scenes.title: The Sixth Place
scenes.synopsis: Sixth and final entry, chapter close, no new dated heading: Day 245, Smoke 6, Sixthday, afternoon into the small hours at the loaf shelf's low angle, the hearth, the salt coat and hollow seat, the kindling, the wheel-shed edge, the clay road at the going of the light and the bed. Smoke goes out without a boundary drawn in the narration; neither of the district's two names for the months is corrected; Smoke 10 (Day 249), the first Account-day and market of the second firing, stands beyond the close and is not brought early. Afternoon thins; heat into the fold; one stiff leathery brown-edged crust two inches from the ear, its empty place unnamed and no third; thread frozen and unwiped; cold at cheek, temple and bare wrist-joint, afterdrop waiting. Garl in objects, his name unspoken two hundred and forty-five days, no collector up or down the clay road on Smoke 4, 5 or 6 (T009/T013/T092). Sella gives the fire its instruction before the basket, tells it the thaw, turns the coals with the back of a broken pot, says *The house will keep it* where another woman would say *I*, counts under her breath toward no opening, pushes coal-black hair back with the burn-wrist, leaves the widow's mark as it was after the one opening before the kiln on Smoke 1 --- touched at no shelf, well, rack, road, basket, afternoon or dusk on any of these three days, because the hand goes to the mark before the kiln and at no other hour; the opening is behind the household and is not looked at again, no lesson made, no payer named (T058/T079, T100). At the kindling Tarn takes the broom only after it is instructed, tells the wood *Six counted. The next I don't count*, sets the knife where six can be checked and the seventh cannot, brings the ear-sentence to the word that would call the loan and stops there with no figure and no name, a remembered stopping and not a new one; nine stoppings, no tenth before the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven, the Seed 16 breath unspent, the loan uncalled, chest tight since the dark, Ash in the knuckles, pale clip-ring at the wrist, warm stone cold and unreconciled in its loft pot (T036/T076, T006). At the wheel-shed Jorra comes through with meal-fine dust past the bent finger, parts dust from slip, tells a pot *You'll do*, withholds the note known three turns ahead, keeps the burned slate at four and the shut-room tellings at two, holds his bent finger in the damper ahead of Sella's unfinished sentence as a remembered repetition paired with no other fraction, gives the men unnamed no name, and keeps *he's not Vail* sealed and the promise neither given nor withdrawn (T035/T031/T062/T065/T095). The boy turns out the file the way a man lays instruments on a towel and finds it exact, complete and worth nothing: six hearings beside and never among with no seventh and none invented to fill the empty place, three near-full answers advanced and unpaid, three pot sayings, the fourth burned-slate telling and the two shut-room tellings, told bell beside heard, told figure beside paid, nine stoppings with no tenth, three held changes plus the loft scrape, the pale line and the held inch on six places, the ninth record-first hand-shape on a place of its own with a finger between it and the eighth and between it and every other private keeping (T080 advanced, not paid), the seventh green a colour and the seventh shape a shape with no eighth, dressed grain covered and unfigured, pan's gone ring on its own tray, the returning-line place gone around with a look and no number, and the question on its seventh place with four askings and no witness standing (T101 carried). Sixth hand question: the hand outside the wool goes up an inch toward the low note through the finger's-width door, through the small intake, the hold and the letting-go of one of Sella's counted breaths in the room that does not touch his, is kept through the little silence after her count has ended and comes down on the river's next low note --- two rhythms crossing in the inch and nowhere else, remembered and not a change made again, filed on the sixth place with no payer named. **Sixty-six** answers stand there now, exact, complete and worth nothing at two inches of air; the count reaches **245** exact, complete, unspent and spoken by nobody in Sarn, Sill or Grath, six months and sixty-five days told by nobody, the fire's fifth unpaid the same number of days, its payer without a name, the seventh year at its very end and still ungiven. The hand lays itself down against the fold like a tool put away, and the count goes forward into Smoke 7, a day that has not yet earned its heading.
